name: MikroTik RouterOS wireless (MIKROTIK-MIB)
_comment: A standalone AP like UniFi. mtxrWlApTable, entry 1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.1.3.1, is the AP-mode table — one row per wireless interface — carrying the SSID it is broadcasting and its client count. Not to be confused with mtxrWlStatTable (.1.1.1.1), which is the station-mode table for a MikroTik acting as a *client*, and would report the network it is joined to rather than the one it serves.
